name: NC500 Driver Gary

intro.text: Five hundred miles round the north coast and I've only reversed into four passing places. Fancy a battle while the kettle boils?

win: Fair play. I'll put that on the blog.
after: Rule of single-track roads: pull into the passing place on your left, or wait opposite one on your right. And wave. Everyone waves. It's the law. Not the actual law. A higher law.
